title: Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #8

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   C. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   C. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Purity of Actions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on dressing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on planting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

3. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. C — Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Surah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Purity of Actions; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on dressing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on planting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
